osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information on the menu. Tabelog lists allergy information as available. Lunch and dinner centre on all-you-can-eat bread, pasta, steak frites and desserts (official menu).
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the à la carte menu has a vegan section — vegan burger, vegetable pasta, minestrone, green salad with vegan chicken, sautéed seasonal vegetables (official menu). Tabelog also lists vegetarian options. Courses are not vegan.
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.hours_raw: Daily breakfast 7:00–11:00 (last order 10:45, buffet), lunch 12:00–15:00 (last order 14:00; lunch bookings limited to 90 minutes), dinner 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:00) (official site; Tabelog lists lunch and dinner). Reservations taken; no seat requests; seat selection unavailable at weekends and holidays (Tabelog). Tabelog says Marriott Bonvoy benefits and discounts do not apply; an October 2026 hotel guest says a Marriott member discount was given. À la carte unavailable on 19, 20, 24, 25 and 31 December 2026 (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and transport IC and other e-money; no QR. 160 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; kids menu; smart casual (Tabelog; official site).
osaka_ohlala_w_osaka.notes: [French · Minamisemba, W Osaka's brasserie on Midosuji] The all-day French brasserie on the third floor of W Osaka, opened March 2021, with big windows over the tree-lined Midosuji and a white, black and blue room with polka-dot touches. Lunch is the popular buy: courses with unlimited bread brought to the table and unlimited desserts. Most 2026 diners loved the bread and the lasagna; some found the single pasta choice limiting, the salad salty or the desserts samey. Dinner centres on steak frites, cooked rare and served with butter or sauce, against the night view. One October 2026 diner writes that the menu was developed with Chef Yusuke Takada of La Cime and the W Osaka chefs. The menu has a vegan section.

roles: Hotel kitchen team unnamed; breads and desserts by the W Osaka pastry and bakery chefs (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: A restaurant of W Osaka, opened 16 March 2021 (Tabelog). The official site describes traditional French cooking fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility, and playful presentation; the name is what the French say when surprised or excited. An October 2026 diner writes that the menu is developed by Chef Yusuke Takada of the two-Michelin-star La Cime together with the W Osaka executive chef team; no other source checked here says so.
chef_bio.philosophy: "Traditional French fused with Japanese ingredients and a modern sensibility" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Steak frites; all-you-can-eat bread and desserts.

anecdotes.text: "The staff regularly came around with fresh bread, and for dessert, we could order from the menu without having to move at all, which was a nice touch." — October 2026, weekday lunch.
"The main dish is only a daily pasta special, so I would have been happier if there were a few more options." — September 2026.
"In the evening, you can enjoy the beautiful night view of Osaka through the large windows, adding a special touch to the hotel dining experience." — October 2026, steak frites course.
"As a Marriott member, I also received a discount." — October 2026, hotel guest (Tabelog says Marriott Bonvoy discounts do not apply).

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (日本語): W大阪の Oh.lala...、朝食からランチ、ディナーまで、御堂筋の並木道が見える窓、白・黒・青のモダンな内装に水玉のアクセント、朝食はブッフェ、3F・160席、朝7:00〜11:00 (L.O.10:45)、ランチ12:00〜15:00 (L.O.14:00)、ディナー17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、伝統的なフレンチに日本の食材とモダンな感性、誕生日の方1名にステーキフリット4品コース無料 (2名以上)、ブーランジェリーディナー、ワインブッフェ、キッズ無料、住所は南船場4-1-3 (英語版のメニューページは「4-3-1 Minami Semba」と表記)。食べログ (店舗会員、英語版): 2021年3月16日オープン、ランチは90分制、席の指定不可、Marriott Bonvoy の特典・割引は対象外、2026年12月の一部日程はアラカルトなし、アレルギー表示あり、ベジタリアン対応、駐車場1時間1,500円 (利用額で無料時間)。口コミ (2026年9月〜10月): パンとデザートの食べ放題、ラザニア、ステーキフリット、夜景、パスタの選択肢が1つ、サラダが塩辛い、デザートの味が似ている、Marriott 会員割引を受けたという声も、La Cime の Yusuke Takada シェフと共同開発という声も。

cultural_comfort.note: A W hotel restaurant whose official site and menu are also in English. No evidence on English-speaking staff in the sources.

existence.note: Official site (W Osaka) and shop-maintained (corporate-member) Tabelog listing with December 2026 notices; reviews dated through October 2026. The English menu page gives the address as 4-3-1 Minami Semba; the Japanese site and Tabelog give 南船場4-1-3.
